datetime.description: When the log entry was seen

datetime-raw.description: Original datetime value from the source export; retain timezone and precision context before normalization.

datetime-unit.description: Explicit unit for a numeric datetime field: s, ms, us or ns. Never inferred from its magnitude.

event-id.description: Source Timesketch/OpenSearch document ID, scoped by sketch/timeline/index context.

parser.description: Source parser or parser chain, when supplied by Plaso/Timesketch.

pathspec.description: JSON representation of the source dfVFS path specification, including parent evidence references.

raw-event.description: Normalized JSON for the complete source record, including API wrapper metadata. Original export bytes remain authoritative.

row-number.description: One-based source record ordinal, excluding CSV headers and blank JSONL lines.

selected.description: Explicit source selection flag. A search hit alone does not imply this flag is true.

sketch-id.description: Source sketch identifier, when supplied. Not an identifier for a newly imported sketch.

source-comments.description: JSON representation of source annotations/comments, including author/time metadata where supplied. Missing comment times are not invented.

source-format.description: Encoding of the selected source export: json, jsonl or csv.

source-index.description: Source OpenSearch index identifier; preserved as provenance rather than an ingestion target.

source-labels.description: JSON representation of source Timesketch labels, retaining sketch scope when supplied. Not automatically active labels in another sketch.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact imported export bytes, not the underlying forensic evidence.

source-tags.description: JSON representation of source tags or Plaso EventTag labels. These are not automatically MISP tags or verdicts.

source-url.description: Explicit URL reference to the source selection, event or investigation. The importer does not fetch it.

timeline-id.description: Source timeline identifier, when supplied. Do not reuse it as an ingestion target.

timeline-name.description: Source timeline name reported by a Timesketch export.

timestamp.description: When the log entry was seen in microseconds since Unix epoch

timestamp_desc.description: Text explaining what type of timestamp is it

description: A timesketch timeline object based on mandatory field in timesketch to describe a log entry.
name: timesketch-timeline
